data.name: InfoName
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an information button (i) whose subject is unknown. InfoNameAbout is the same button with a subject.

data.name: InfoNameAbout
data.comment: Screen-reader name of an information button (i) beside a setting; {0} = what the information is about, often the setting label as written, capital letter included.

data.name: PromptCancel
data.comment: Cancel button of a one-line text prompt, left of the confirm button in two equal columns. Closes the prompt without changing anything.
